subject.title: Feishu Bitable write operations return 400 after bot/app replacement

question: Should Feishu Bitable table tools remain app-credential-only with better setup diagnostics, or should OpenClaw add user-auth behavior for table-level operations after app replacement?
rationale: The current source proves the affected tools use app credentials, but the missing live Feishu error prevents automation from choosing between permission diagnostics and a new auth model with storage/config implications.

options.title: Require live error proof first
options.body: Keep this open and ask for the exact Feishu 400 JSON/code/log_id and sanitized account/scope shape before changing auth behavior.

options.title: Approve user-auth design
options.body: If Feishu proof shows bot/app credentials cannot safely cover these table operations, sponsor a plugin-owned user-token design with explicit migration and setup evidence.

options.title: Treat as setup diagnostics
options.body: If the error is scope, publication, or resource-sharing setup, keep app-credential behavior and improve diagnostics/docs around replaced apps and Bitable writes.

recommendation.title: Require live error proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this open and ask for the exact Feishu 400 JSON/code/log_id and sanitized account/scope shape before changing auth behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The plugin is documented as community maintained by this handle, and the timeline already routed this report toward them.
